clips.title: The story
paras: Thun'grim Firegaze sends Horde warriors across the Great Sea for Velora Nitely's Brutal Legguards. In the Undercity, the Forsaken smith draws on the craft she kept from her mortal life to forge the armor. Her work helps assemble a durable suit for the Horde's warriors.

Thun'grim Firegaze sends you east across the Great Sea to find a smith for the Brutal Legguards. You've proved your mettle to the veteran smith at his vigil in the Barrens, and now he points you toward the fabled Brutal Armor. Thun'grim cannot make the whole suit alone, so he relies on skilled allies across the Horde. The greaves call for an artisan whose work was revered before northern humanity fell, in the Forsaken's underground kingdom.

Velora Nitely works in the Undercity's Trade Quarter, where her old craft still serves the Horde. Before the Scourging of the north ended her mortal life, she was one of the Kingdom of Lordaeron's foremost armorsmiths. Her homeland was corrupted, and she became one of the Forsaken, but death did not take her mastery of metal. She now turns her human skill toward the Horde's warriors, with a dry, macabre wit about being undead.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It is said that, before her death, Velora Nitely was one of the finest armorsmiths in Lordaeron. Death, it seems, has not decreased her talents. Speak with Velora—she will make your brutal legguards.
Velora plies her trade in the Undercity of Lordaeron, in the trade quarter.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You are here for leg armor? Great!
Um... Am I making the armor for you, or are you making it for me?
That was joke. Was it funny? I can't tell... I lost my sense of humor the same time I lost my sense of smell. Which was about the same time I stopped breathing.
